snippet.title: The only way to caramelize onions perfectly 🧅🙌 #cooking #foodhacks #kitchen
snippet.description:
THE 4 STAGES OF CARAMELIZED ONIONS — COOK ONIONS LIKE A CHEF! 🧅

The same onion can produce four completely different flavors, textures and culinary applications, depending on how far you cook it.

From mild, translucent sweated onions to intensely savory-sweet, mahogany-colored caramelized onions, understanding these four stages can fundamentally change the way you cook.

In this video, I demonstrate my covered-steam, press-and-scrape method to develop incredible flavor without adding sugar or baking soda.

RECIPE DETAILS

Cooking time: Approximately 35–50 minutes
Pan: 12-inch stainless steel or cast iron skillet

INGREDIENTS
• Yellow onions — 900g (5–6 medium, weighed after peeling)
• Neutral oil — 15g
• Unsalted butter — 28g
• Salt — 3g (use 2g if cooking the entire batch to stage 4)
• Water — 60ml, for initial steaming
• Additional water — 1–2 tbsp per deglaze

For a 10-inch pan, reduce onions to 600g, oil to 10g, butter to 19g, salt to 2g and initial water to 40ml.

METHOD

1. SLICE THE ONIONS
Peel and slice the onions pole to pole (root to tip), approximately 3mm thick. Cutting parallel to the fibre helps the onion strands retain their structure instead of turning mushy during prolonged cooking.

2. COVERED STEAM PHASE
Add onions, oil, butter, salt and 60ml water to the pan. Cover and cook over high heat for 6–7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Trapped steam transfers heat efficiently throughout the pile, softening the onions and reducing their volume.

3. EVAPORATE THE WATER
Remove the lid and continue over high heat for approximately 6–12 minutes, stirring every 30–60 seconds. Listen carefully: when wet bubbling changes to a distinct sizzling sound, reduce to medium-high heat. This signals that most free water has evaporated and rapid browning can begin.

4. PRESS AND SCRAPE
Press the onions against the hot pan using a flat spatula for approximately 30 seconds. Scrape, redistribute and leave undisturbed for 60–90 seconds before repeating. Shorten these intervals as the onions darken. Direct contact with hot metal encourages browning.

5. DEGLAZE
When the fond (the browned layer sticking to the pan) becomes dark brown but not burnt, add 1–2 tbsp water carefully. Scrape and dissolve the fond back into the onions. Repeat as necessary, typically 4–8 times throughout the browning process. Deglaze according to color, not a fixed schedule.

6. FINAL CARAMELIZATION
As the onions become deeply golden, reduce to medium heat. Press and scrape every 30–45 seconds, deglazing whenever necessary. Stop when the onions become dark brown, sticky, glossy and jam-like. Rest off the heat for 1 minute and adjust seasoning.

THE FOUR STAGES OF ONION COOKING

STAGE 1 — SWEATED ONIONS 
Appearance: Translucent, soft, no browning.
Flavour: Mild, delicate sweetness.
Approximate weight: 650–720g.
Best for: White sauces, risotto, cream soups and korma gravies.

STAGE 2 — LIGHT GOLDEN
Appearance: Pale golden with lightly browned edges.
Flavor: Sweet, aromatic and lightly toasted.
Approximate weight: 450–520g.
Best for: Sabzi, pulao, omelettes, sandwiches and Indian gravy bases.

STAGE 3 — DEEP GOLDEN-AMBER 
Appearance: Deep golden-brown, silky and soft.
Flavor: Rich sweetness with savory complexity.
Approximate weight: 300–360g.
Best for: Burgers, pizza, grilled cheese, onion tarts and French onion dip.

STAGE 4 — MAHOGANY & JAMMY
Appearance: Dark brown, sticky and spreadable.
Flavor: Intensely concentrated, savory-sweet.
Approximate weight: 190–250g.
Best for: French onion soup, onion jam, gourmet sauces and sandwich spreads.

THE SCIENCE BEHIND CARAMELIZED ONIONS
• Moisture: Onions contain a large amount of water. Removing free moisture allows their surface temperature to rise and browning to accelerate.
• Maillard reaction: Reducing sugars react with amino compounds, creating complex aromas, flavours and brown pigments.
• Caramelization: Heat-driven sugar reactions contribute additional colour and flavour as moisture decreases.
• Fond: Deglazing recovers concentrated browned flavour while preventing scorching.
• Natural sweetness: Water loss concentrates the onion's existing sugars. Added sugar is unnecessary.

CARAMELIZED ONIONS VS BIRISTA
Birista is deep-fried until crisp and brittle, while caramelized onions are slowly transformed into a soft, sticky, concentrated mixture. Different techniques, textures and culinary purposes.

CHEF TIPS
• Use a wide, flat pan instead of a wok.
• Keep the lid OFF during evaporation.
• Don't stir constantly; allow contact with hot metal.
• Deglaze dark brown fond, never burnt black fond.
• Watch closely during the final 10 minutes.
• Cool promptly, refrigerate for up to 3–4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

All cooking times and yields are estimates. Trust color, texture, aroma and sound rather than the clock.

snippet.description:
#rufian #elecciones #debate 

Entrevista exclusiva en Diario AS a Gabriel Rufián, portavoz de ERC en el Congreso de los Diputados. Repasamos la actualidad de la política deportiva en España, el papel del Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD) y la necesidad de un Ministerio del Deporte exclusivo. Además, Rufián analiza la polémica por la sede de la final del Mundial 2030, la gestión de Javier Tebas en LaLiga y Pedro Rocha/Rafael Louzán en la RFEF, el auge del fútbol femenino y su visión sobre la relación entre deporte, selecciones autonómicas y sociedad. 

En la parte más personal, confiesa qué significa ser aficionado del RCD Espanyol en Cataluña, sus recuerdos con el fútbol y el tenis de Rafa Nadal, y cómo el deporte refleja el liderazgo en la política.

snippet.title: 한국 핵잠수함 건조에 중국 '딴지'..미국은 "문제 없어" (자막뉴스) / SBS
snippet.description:
한국의 핵추진잠수함 도입 추진을 두고 미국과 중국이 국제원자력기구, IAEA에서 정면으로 충돌했습니다.

중국이 IAEA 전체 회원국의 사전 합의가 필요하다고 제동을 걸자 미국 정부가 반박한 겁니다.

미국의소리 보도에 따르면 미 국무부는 IAEA가 개별 회원국과 핵물질 안전조치에 관한 협상을 진행할 고유 권한을 갖고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

전체 회원국의 사전 합의가 필요하다는 중국의 주장에 선을 그은 겁니다.

앞서 지난 18일 열린 IAEA 이사회에서 중국은 한미 핵추진잠수함 협력이 비평화적 목적의 핵물질 이전을 수반한다고 주장했습니다.

그러면서 한국과 IAEA 간 기술 협의에만 맡겨둘 것이 아니라 전체 회원국 차원의 논의와 합의가 선행돼야 한다고 요구했습니다.

하지만 미국은 한국과 IAEA의 협의가 IAEA의 기존 권한과 한국의 핵확산금지조약상 의무에 부합한다는 입장입니다.

유럽연합도 한국이 핵물질 관련 신고 의무를 충실히 이행하고 있다고 평가했습니다.

앞서 미국은 지난해 11월 한미 정상회담 공동 설명자료를 통해 한국의 핵추진잠수함 건조를 승인했습니다.

우리 정부는 2030년대 중반 첫 핵추진잠수함 진수를 목표로 사업을 추진하고 있습니다.

한국과 IAEA는 지난달 첫 기술 협의를 진행했으며, 내년에도 관련 협의를 이어갈 예정입니다.

IAEA는 한국과의 협의가 마무리되면 관련 약정을 이사회에 제출할 방침입니다.
